limits: Local software fixtures only; no external provider, physical isolation, price, release or Human acceptance qualification.

The new shared helper actually invokes the server-owned Native draft conformance service with four controlled HTTP probes. It retains canonical hidden Tasks, paused zero-tool C0 Plans, Run identities, pre-spend reservations, exact wire receipts, three completed outcomes and one unknown cancellation liability.
Only the primary binding is qualified inside the ephemeral fixture database; the distinct peer credential/profile remains unqualified for ordinary work.

The stream check denotes dispatch/progress event retention; requests use stream:false. Stateless NONE responses test server request formation under a deterministic stub, not provider-side memory retention.

The existing other authority cases remain component fixtures; their discovery metadata is not newly claimed as provider qualification. Railway effects use the fixed local GraphQL contract and canonical catalog/credential owners, never a live provider.
The SDK diagnostic changes and unique per-journey gateway name pass TypeScript; actual managed OpenCode results remain separate and unresolved.
Earlier failed/resource-stopped attempts remain private diagnostics and are not included in the passing count.
